name: Fresh Fortified Soyabean Oil (5L)
description: 5-liter fortified cooking soyabean oil processed through a multi-step refining system including degumming, balanced decolorization, and five-stage deodorization. Fortified with essential Vitamin A and formulated to preserve natural Beta-carotene with an optimal balanced ratio of Omega-3 and Omega-6 fatty acids for healthy family cooking.
